selection.summary: Fixes for NodeBB v4.4.3 notification dropdown and fork/move category-selector issues. (1) Notifications: in public/src/modules/notifications.js the notification click handler toggled via components.get('notifications/list') (stale global element) instead of the actual notifList (h2/h17: lines ~44-55), causing toggle/race glitches; changed to notifList.dropdown('toggle'). Also re-binding 'mark-all-read' on every load stacked duplicate handlers (h2 line 60-64, h25); fixed with .off('click', '.mark-all-read').on(...). Async loading itself is via socket 'notifications.get' with hooks/parseAndTranslate (h2/h13) — the re-binding was the race/glitch source. (2) Category selector dropup: fork.js (h1/h15) and move.js (h3/h16) init the selector inside modals; categorySearch.js (h4/h14) handles show.bs.dropdown without correcting an inherited 'dropup' class, so the menu opens in the wrong place in modals. Patched categorySearch.js show.bs.dropdown handler to re-evaluate space above/below the toggle at open time, removing 'dropup' when there is room below and applying it only when space above exceeds below — same approach as the established dropup positioning pattern in postTools.js (h19) and threadTools.js (h11). Both fixes are applied to the working tree (edits to public/src/modules/notifications.js and public/src/modules/categorySearch.js succeeded against base commit 8fd8079a84d8e71ab02eaa69ef15cb33fcea85c7); no template changes were needed since 'dropup' is not present in scanned modals/templates.
